data.one_liner: Group multiple Riverpod AsyncValues into a single AsyncValue
data.what_it_does: It groups several Riverpod AsyncValues together into a single AsyncValue, allowing you to retrieve all data values as a tuple. This enables calling AsyncValue.when only once when multiple asynchronous providers are needed in a widget.
use_when: You need to consume multiple Riverpod AsyncValues in a single widget and want to avoid nesting multiple .when() calls.
You want to wait for multiple asynchronous processes together and handle their states cleanly.
avoid_when: You are not using Riverpod for state management.
You only need to watch a single AsyncValue.
strengths: Simplifies widget build methods by reducing multiple AsyncValue.when calls down to one.
Easily handles grouping of multiple providers into tuples.
weaknesses: No topics documented in the package metadata.
